problem_statement: Consultation rooms are assigned by the receptionist. Two doctors were given the same room at the same hour. Please build us a system that fixes this.
twist: Free on this date - Return available rooms for requested date using NOT EXISTS logic; reject end_date < start_date with HTTP 400; prevent overlapping bookings with HTTP 409.

members.name: Member 1 [Student Name Placeholder]
members.responsibilities: Express application setup, route architecture, HTTP status code enforcement, request logging middleware, global error handling.

members.name: Member 2 [Student Name Placeholder]
members.responsibilities: Relational SQLite database schema design (doctors, rooms, bookings), PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON, constraints, seed data, database initialization script.

members.name: Member 3 [Student Name Placeholder]
members.responsibilities: Complete CRUD endpoints for doctors, rooms, and bookings, plus SQL JOIN details endpoint (/bookings/details) combining doctor and room data.

members.name: Member 4 [Student Name Placeholder]
members.responsibilities: Input validation middleware for types and formats, descriptive HTTP 400 error responses, query parameter searching (e.g. GET /rooms?floor=2).

members.name: Member 5 [Student Name Placeholder]
members.responsibilities: Core Assignment Twist: GET /rooms/available?date=YYYY-MM-DD using SQL NOT EXISTS, date validation (end < start -> 400), overlapping booking prevention (409), and passing Compulsory Tests 1, 2, and 3.

members.name: Member 6 [Student Name Placeholder]
members.responsibilities: Comprehensive Postman v2.1 collection and environment with automated assertion scripts, test runner, full project documentation, and deployment guides.
